sections.label: Engagement, economy, wages, infrastructure progress
sections.summary: Singapore deepened engagement, advocated free trade, saw steady growth and real wage rises, and opened transport and housing projects.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We deepened our engagement with neighbours, as well as major global powers.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We advocated for free trade against rising protectionism and helped to conclude the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The economy recorded steady growth, especially in 2017, which we hope will extend into 2018.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Real wages rose steadily for all income groups.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The Government, industries and unions are partnering one another to implement the recommendations of the Committee on the Future Economy.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We opened Changi Terminal 4, launched 46,000 new Build-To-Order (BTO) units, completed the addition of 1,000 more buses and opened new Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) lines.

sections.label: Education and social safety nets
sections.summary: Education was strengthened at all levels and social safety nets enhanced, with support from KidSTART to Silver Support.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We strengthened education at all levels – from preschool for toddlers to lifelong learning opportunities for all ages.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We enhanced social safety nets and provided more support for the vulnerable – from KidSTART for at-risk young children to Silver Support for seniors who had earned low incomes.

sections.label: National Gallery and multiracial Constitution
sections.summary: The National Gallery opened with a Nanyang style exhibition, and the Constitution was amended to reflect multiracial values.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The National Gallery opened to the public, including a permanent exhibition of the unique Nanyang style of painting.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We amended the Constitution to reflect our multiracial values, by ensuring that all ethnic groups have a chance to be represented in the highest office in the land.

sections.label: Tackling inequality before it entrenches
sections.summary: The passage warns that inequality, especially children's differing starting points, must be tackled before it becomes entrenched.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: If the same happens to us, our politics will turn vicious, our society will fracture and our nation will wither.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We must tackle inequality, particularly the increasingly dissimilar starting points of children from different family backgrounds, before the problem becomes entrenched in our society.

sections.label: Fourth-generation leadership taking shape
sections.summary: The fourth-generation leadership team is taking shape and more responsibilities, and will uphold foundational values.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: In the meantime, the fourth-generation leadership team is taking shape, and taking on more responsibilities.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: They will have to confront the question, "What is next for Singapore?" Like their predecessors, the fourth-generation leaders will uphold our foundational values – multiracialism, meritocracy, incorruptibility, self-reliance, inclusivity and openness to the world.

sections.label: Fourth-generation leaders and nation-building
sections.summary: The fourth-generation leaders will work with fellow Singaporeans on the next phase of nation-building.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The fourth-generation leaders will work with fellow Singaporeans to undertake the next phase of nation-building.

sections.label: Relations with US and China
sections.summary: It states that good relations will be pursued with both the US and China.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: In particular, we will work for good relations with both the US and China.

sections.label: Collaboration with China
sections.summary: It states continued collaboration with China, including participating in the Belt and Road Initiative.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Through China's four decades of reform and opening up, generations of leaders in both countries have worked closely together.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will continue to collaborate with China in its next phase of development, including participating in the Belt and Road Initiative.

sections.label: Air base and port moves
sections.summary: It states that moving Paya Lebar Air Base and the city ports will free land and double the Central Business District.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: When Paya Lebar Air Base moves to Changi, it will free up an area larger than Ang Mo Kio for redevelopment.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Moving the city ports to Tuas will double the size of the Central Business District.

sections.label: SkillsFuture and Adapt and Grow
sections.summary: It states SkillsFuture will anchor lifelong learning and Adapt and Grow will match workers to jobs.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: SkillsFuture will anchor this national culture of lifelong learning for skills mastery.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: Adapt and Grow will match workers to jobs and help them stay employable as industries and jobs change.

sections.label: Elderly infrastructure and healthcare
sections.summary: It states elderly-friendly infrastructure will be enhanced and healthcare kept affordable through subsidies and schemes.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will enhance elderly-friendly infrastructure, including new housing options, and healthcare and fitness facilities.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: We will keep healthcare affordable through well-designed healthcare subsidies, MediShield Life, MediFund and enhancements to ElderShield.

sections.label: Singapore Bicentennial 2019
sections.summary: It states the 2019 Singapore Bicentennial will be an occasion to trace roots and draw inspiration.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The Singapore Bicentennial in 2019 – 200 years after Stamford Raffles landed in Singapore – will be an occasion to trace our roots and draw inspiration for the journey ahead.

sections.label: Fourth-generation leadership and young Singaporeans
sections.summary: The fourth-generation leadership must mobilise young Singaporeans' spirit and energy, grow with the people, embrace diverse views, and forge unity of purpose and action.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The fourth-generation leadership must fire up and mobilise the spirit and energy of young Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: They must grow with the people they represent; embrace a diversity of views and ideas; and yet forge a clarity of purpose and unity of action.

sections.label: Leaders, people and trust
sections.summary: Leaders must stand firm on principles, listen to people, lead on difficult policies, and each generation must forge trust afresh through shared trials.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: There will be moments of truth, when they have to stand firm on principles and ideals while seeking practical resolutions.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: They will need to listen to the views and feelings of the people and, by their words and deeds, show that they have heard; yet never fear to lead and mobilise public opinion to support difficult policies in the long-term interest of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: The trust between the people and their leaders is not automatically passed on from one generation to the next.

sentences.speaker: The President (Mdm Halimah Yacob)
sentences.text: In each generation, the people and leaders must work with one another, go through trials and tribulations together, and forge their own bonds afresh.
